tagline: Free, curated Islamic video courses from public sources

blockers.title: I can't push to GitHub (403)
blockers.detail: Push to reality-farouqk/talaqqa was refused. Fix: reconnect GitHub at https://claude.ai/connect-github and make sure the Claude GitHub App is installed on the talaqqa repo. The tracker commit is ready locally and goes up once access works.

blockers.title: Engine: YouTube API key + trusted channels
blockers.detail: Add a YouTube Data API v3 key as the GitHub secret YOUTUBE_API_KEY (free, Google Cloud console). List the channels you trust for auto-publishing in content/discovery/config.json (trusted_channels, YouTube channel IDs starting with UC). Until you add channels, everything goes to the review PR.

blockers.title: Approve real courses for launch
blockers.detail: Candidate list under Phase 1 is now organised by path and level. You can approve these, add your own, or wait for the engine's ranked shortlist.

blockers.title: YouTube is blocked from my build environment
blockers.detail: I can't open youtube.com or the Data API, so I can't verify video IDs. Fix: allow youtube.com, www.youtube-nocookie.com, i.ytimg.com and www.googleapis.com in the session's network settings, and add a YouTube Data API key as a secret. Alternative: send me the playlist links and I verify them once access is allowed.

blockers.title: Starter code is on 'master'; 'main' holds only a README
blockers.detail: Your brief says 'main stays deployable'. Proposal: make main the default branch and merge master into it in the first Phase 1 PR. Also: db/0001_init.sql is not in the repo (db/README.md says to add it). Please commit it or send it.

blockers.title: Name: Talaqqa or Halaqa?
blockers.detail: The code, manifest and LICENSE say 'Talaqqa'; the brief says 'Halaqa'. I'll keep Talaqqa unless you say otherwise.

blockers.title: Accounts and services for launch
blockers.detail: Needed before release: Cloudflare account access (Pages project + API token as a CI secret), the custom domain, a contact email for removal requests, and approval of Cloudflare Web Analytics (cookieless) and an error monitor (Sentry free tier, or a tiny Cloudflare Worker that logs errors).

blockers.title: Dependency approval: @astrojs/check
blockers.detail: Dev-only package so CI can type-check (astro check). No runtime cost. Everything else in Phase 1 uses what's already installed.

phases.name: Launch
phases.goal: Real users can learn Arabic and Islam step by step, from the basics to advanced, with no account.
phases.outcome: Anyone can open the site on a phone, pick the Arabic or Islam path, start at Foundations, play lessons in order, and keep their progress on their device.
definitionOfDone: Live on the real domain over HTTPS, deployed by CI from main.
5 to 10 approved courses; every video ID verified as real, public and embeddable; every lesson credits the teacher and links to the original.

Phone smoke test passes on the deployed build: install the PWA (Android prompt, iOS hint), play a lesson, mark complete, save to watchlist, 'continue where you left off', go offline and browse visited pages, see the offline notice on a lesson.
Lighthouse (mobile) on home, course and lesson pages: Performance 90+, Accessibility 95+, SEO 100, Best Practices 95+.
Valid sitemap, canonical tags, Open Graph, Course and VideoObject JSON-LD (Rich Results Test passes).
An Arabic (RTL) test page renders without layout breaks.
About, Content guidelines, Report a problem / request removal, and Privacy pages are live and linked in the footer.
README, CONTRIBUTING, LICENSE, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, issue templates, CI (build + content validation + type check) green on main.
You have approved the content and said 'launch'.

changelog.text: Added the discovery engine (your choices: trusted teachers auto-publish, free word-list sentiment, built now). Video-first redesign. Player with speed, autoplay, auto-next, resume. Security headers. Applied your engineering guidelines: no new dependencies, timeouts, env-only secrets, tests.

Phase 1 started on demo content. Built the curriculum (Learn Arabic and Learn Islam, Foundations → Advanced, subjects), path pages, catalog by subject, on-device progress, PWA offline + install prompt, SEO, trust pages, CI and templates. Proposed the content discovery engine. All still local: GitHub push blocked.
